description: Tempo--Zonen Wuppertal is a series of datasets listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Der Datensatz enthält die punktförmigen Beschilderungsstandorte der insgesamt 164 Tempo-30-Zonen im Wuppertaler Stadtgebiet. Er wurde im Zeitraum 08/2008 bis 09/2008 vom Ressort "Straßen und Verkehr" in einer konzertierten Aktion durch Digitalisierung der vorhandenen analogen Akten und Pläne, insbesondere der verkehrsrechtlichen Anordnungen, erzeugt. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are beschilderung, gdi-w, geo, geschwindigkeitsbeschränkung, lärmbekämpfung. It offers 7 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GEOJSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/KML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/SHP, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/XML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
